checks.title: Cloud Composer literal configuration has no detected secrets
checks.native_identity: Exact requested project scope and full response name; concrete request location/resource bound when present. Workbench list may use locations/-; Composer list requires a concrete region. No project alias inference or extra identity API added.
checks.omission: Omitted optional literal maps on present complete unmasked parent mean no configured values in that map. Missing config/softwareConfig or gceSetup, existing scrub/name projections, malformed types, masks or incomplete data remain UNKNOWN.
checks.reference_limits: DAG GCS prefix, package references and external script/URL strings are only returned configuration; no target content, disk/notebook files, packages or managed secrets are fetched.
evidence_sentences: A likely secret was detected in the returned Cloud Composer literal configuration.
The value is hidden; detection did not validate the credential.
checks.remediation: Remove literal credentials from Cloud Composer configuration, use supported secret references and rotate confirmed exposed credentials.

scope_and_activation.selection: Exact internally engine-derived composer_environment/workbench_instance selected kind only; absent/wrong selection or nonboolean true never invokes detectors. Category/framework selection is not authority.
scope_and_activation.calls: No new service read, enumeration or identity requests; inspect only successful original existing native list/get JSON before sanitize/cache. Existing collector scope/location discovery remains unchanged.
scope_and_activation.default_off: Always remove all selected literal values before cache even without scanning; scans disabled => no producer marker and UNKNOWN callback.
scope_and_activation.representation: Request must be GET on exact HTTPS fixed host/version/project/location/resource path with no body, fields mask or URL query; current list contract supports pageSize/pageToken only. Native filter/orderBy requests not used by collector remain unsupported for clean scans.

projection.composer: Remove envVariables, airflowConfigOverrides and pypiPackages values and legacy name lists; mark each map unavailable on softwareConfig._coverage. Keep unrelated genuine security settings.
projection.workbench: Both metadata and systemMetadata retain recognized safe security values, with other values None and per-key unavailable coverage. Known invalid security values remain None/unavailable; absence on full native response remains distinguishable from removal.
projection.free_form: Recursively drop descriptions, labels and annotations with nested unavailable field coverage, even on pages with no detected values, to avoid cross-page duplicate retention.
projection.detected_reflections: scan_content _redact_values callback supplies exact detected values to shared redact_matches before serialization; known repetitions in other retained fields are hidden and changed facts get unavailable coverage.
projection.generic_sanitize: Existing shared sanitize still runs; some sensitive names and their per-key coverage (for example startup-script) disappear entirely. Those values cannot be consumed as collected facts.
projection.security_compatibility: Current gcp_workbench_review root/public-IP predicates accept retained true settings, use full-response omitted-root documented default, and reject removed invalid values; direct compatibility test covers all three.

bounds.shared_across_kinds_pages: Root initializes one new_budget per Transport; its lock serializes updates. Standalone callers omitting budget get response-local limits only.
bounds.per_engine_timeout: min(5 seconds, half remaining content deadline)
bounds.native_transport: Existing transport request/deadline/cancel/page limits remain in force. This projection bounds scanned content, not generic existing HTTP JSON body size; it adds no media reader.

detectors.verification: not_attempted; existing pinned offline shared adapters, no validators/revokers or credential validation
detectors.privacy: No raw selected values, matches, scanner output, snippets or exception text returned/cached; only redacted leaks, constant locations, byte/engine/field coverage. Descriptions/labels/annotations intentionally unavailable.
detectors.dedup: Shared process-keyed exact-value HMAC and merge_leaks dedup both tools and existing finding merge dedups both owners. One cross-owner synthetic value tested; cross-run/cross-process identity and every other service combination not separately proven.
detectors.incomplete: Denied reads never project/scan. Incomplete pages/collections, bounds, absent/failed engines, malformed values, unbound identities or contradictory producer evidence => UNKNOWN, never secret absence.

tests.native_proof: Actual installed GCPCollector.collect, existing Composer/Workbench list jobs, root-installed Transport pre-cache hook and downstream scrubs; only native HTTP responses and fake credential headers mocked. No scheduling/projection fallback injection.
tests.isolation: Autouse tests and case exporter block Python socket.connect/connect_ex/create_connection and DNS getaddrinfo, including an explicit escape assertion. No OS subprocess egress isolation attested; detector offline flags are shared existing controls.
tests.real_tools: Both services positive/negative, PyPI-only literal, Workbench systemMetadata-only literal, clean external reference and cross-owner exact-value dedup use real installed detectors. Other contract tests use clean engine stubs where detector mechanics are irrelevant.

tests.attribution: Reuses existing actual GCPCollector/Transport, scan_content/redact_matches and finding HMAC merge implementations. Directly exercises existing gcp_workbench_review predicates; no existing test suites rerun.

runtime_cases.unknown_source: Valid native-shaped configured string above16KiB adapter bound, produced through actual collector, not hand-authored private markers.

integration.pre_cache: project_response(successful original JSON, enabled=exact boolean, selected_kinds=internal selection, budget=one shared new_budget(), check_cancelled=transport.check_cancelled)
integration.observed: Root-installed pre-cache endpoint restriction, shared budget initialization, registry invocation, engine named selection and exact secrets finding-type mapping observed. Worker did not edit shared files.
integration.downstream: Preserve scanner marker and nested coverage; Composer map removal and Workbench metadata scrub must not overwrite safe coverage/provenance.

unresolved_contracts: Fixtures are native-shaped synthetic JSON, not real-cloud responses; no authorization or Google create/update acceptance certified. In particular PyPI credentials test only proves inspection of a returned string, not that Composer accepts arbitrary credential-bearing version specifications.
No all-DAG source, notebook filesystem/disk, external URL, image/package/archive, Secret Manager or managed password store coverage.
Output-only Workbench systemMetadata is inspected as returned configuration; no runtime/file-content meaning inferred.
Strict project-scope string equality rejects unproven project ID/number aliases instead of manufacturing native binding.
Root-owned full planner/catalog/ledger/hosted routing is outside this focused producer proof; shared source hashes pin observed state only.
Unsupported list filters/orderBy/fields masks, overly large native values and incomplete locations remain UNKNOWN.
Some generic sanitizer key removals also remove coverage entries; no retained sensitive value is asserted, and existing policy switch defaults are separately tested.
